the free encyclopedia Dominican Republic volleyball player (born 1988) Ana Ligia Fabian Personal information Full name Ana Ligia Fabian Hernández Nickname Anali Born ( 1988-11-07 ) November 7, 1988 (age 37) Santo Domingo , Dominican Republic Hometown Santo Domingo Height 1.79 m (5 ft 10 + 1 ⁄ 2 in) Weight 51 kg (112 lb) Spike 310 cm (122 in) Block 305 cm (120 in) Volleyball information Position Wing Spiker Number 8 National team Dominican Republic Ana Ligia Fabian Hernández (born November 7, 1988) is a volleyball player from the Dominican Republic , who participated in the 2007 Junior World Championship [ 1 ] in Thailand . She competed as wing spiker, wearing the #4 jersey. At the 2006 U-20 NORCECA Women´s Junior Continental Championship , she took with her team the silver medal. [ 2 ] She participated with Ingrid Carmona at the NORCECA Beach Volleyball Circuit in 2007 [ 3 ] and 2009 with Ysaires Restituyo , [ 4 ] finishing in 11th and 9th position.
